newsitem.title: USA: Fastlane Footwear closes $1.5 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Fastlane Footwear closes $1.5 mln credit pact.

text.p: Fastlane Footwear Inc FSLF.OB said Tuesday it secured a $1.5 million loan which completes the second phase of a financing plan.
The company makes athletic footwear featuring logos and trademarks for motorsports like NASCAR and Brickyard 400.

Fastlane said the National Canada Business Corp will provide a $1.5 million loan in a three year agreement. The amount of the loan may increase if the company meets certain sales and inventory targets.
In a first phase this week, the company also closed a preferred stock placement of 250,000 shares at $4 each and received proceeds of $1 million.
Shares of Fastlane closed at two yesterday.
